rationale: No existing Playwright E2E touches print mode (grep for printMode/dashboard-print-btn/o2-print-page/preparePrintLayout returned nothing under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests). The only coverage is a shallow unit spec RenderDashboardCharts.spec.ts (print flag lines 522-565). The feature is a distinct user-facing flow (print/report capture) with no sibling spec that fits it; the closest area specs (dashboard-table-chart, dashboard-share-link, dashboard) test unrelated concerns. A new spec is warranted, placed in Dashboards/ and registered under the Dashboards-Core shard where general dashboard specs live.
